item.title: Version 2.0.20
item.description:
- CopyCat Clipboard V2 is here!
- Refined new design and improved security with AES-GCM encryption and App Lock. - Ultra-fast, low-latency sync with a hybrid local network + cloud approach. - Bi-directional sync across all supported operating systems. - WebDAV storage, screen recorder protection, and Text Transformers. - Performance improvements, bug fixes, and stability enhancements.
